about.title: About us
about.description: The draft Sisterhood vision: connecting women through exchange, creative work and mutual support. A clear explanation of the project idea and demo.
about.heading: Connection begins with what we share.
about.intro: Sisterhood is an idea for a place where women can meet, share experiences and make their creative work visible. This prototype explores what that place could look like.
about.draftText: This project description is a preliminary draft. Its aims, content and direction still need agreement. The prototype does not document existing services, partnerships or real activities.
about.exchangeText: Ask a question, share a thought or discover another perspective: exchange should make the first connection possible.
about.craftText: Behind a piece of work are people, knowledge and personal journeys. Sisterhood aims to make that connection visible and bring women and their ideas together.
about.supportText: Sharing knowledge, listening closely and learning from each other: mutual support is the guiding idea behind this vision.
about.worldText: The idea has an international outlook. It aims to connect different experiences and perspectives while recognising the differences between places and people.
about.visionText: Graz and New Zealand are the starting point of the project vision. This is a proposed direction, not evidence of an existing network or shared activities.
about.examplesText: The existing example profiles and products refer to Kenya and Europe. They are fictional demo content and do not yet represent the proposed Graz–New Zealand connection.
about.discoverTitle: Explore the idea in the prototype
about.discoverText: Find example posts in the community feed. Meet the fictional people and discover their creative work in the member directory.
